workload.scrollInput: Scripted ADB touchscreen swipes with 60 ms gesture duration
workload.100ItemAndroidBaseline: Captured on the unlocked Samsung SM-A325F using the same profile fixture. Feed100 used 50 scripted 60 ms swipes and exceeded the frame budget; roots100 narrowly met it. See additionalMeasurements.android100.

measurement.acceptance: fewer than 5% of frames over 16.67 ms
measurement.note: Threshold corresponds to the T27 60 Hz budget; device display remained at its active 90 Hz setting. Samples span screen entry, scripted scroll gestures and screen exit.

commentsRoots100.note: p95 is 5 microseconds below the 16.67 ms threshold; one maximum outlier was 192.529 ms

lifecycle.devicePssSource: adb shell dumpsys meminfo TOTAL PSS, KB
lifecycle.limitation: Synthetic CursorListController fixture cycles; not a live FeedScreen, real API, five-minute cache-TTL wait, or production cache retention check. PSS is process-wide and showed modest variation.

scrollAnchor.note: Physical profile fixture grew an unanchored sliver header by 96 logical px after the host captured anchor-item-0.
